name: Flash Git

bonuses.name: Addicted to Dakka
bonuses.text: This Threat always counts as an Adversary for the purposes of determining how much Ammo it has.

bonuses.name: 'Ere We Go!
bonuses.text: If this Threat is Engaged at the start of its Turn, it gains +2 damage to melee attacks.

options.name: MORE DAKKA!
options.text: For every ten Flash Gitz in the Mob one may have

options.name: Gitfinda Squig
options.text: The Flash Git gains a +4 bonus dice to ranged attack tests. The Gitfinda Squig uses the same statistics as a Squig, but cannot attack.

mobAbilities.name: Mob Rule
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of Flash Gitz gains +1 bonus Icon to any Resolve Tests. This increases by +1 for every ten Flash Gitz.

note: Heading reads Flash Git, stat block title reads Flash Gitz. Printed as "MOB ACTIONS": MORE DAKKA! and Gitfinda Squig, kept as mob options. Resilience prints "11(AR 4)"; the MORE DAKKA! sentence is unfinished as printed.
